title: Café de Quatro
style: 50s jazz with smoky upright bass walking in 4/4, brushed snare, ride cymbal ping, muted trumpet replies, and tenor sax fills; verse glides in close harmony across English, Portuguese, French, and Italian, pre-chorus opens with softer trio vocals, chorus blooms with stacked close-harmony call-and-response and short horn stabs. Warm analog mix, intimate and velvety, with tape hiss, room bloom, and little trumpet pickups between lines., vocal, harmony, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Come sit by the blue-lit bar
Meu bem, you know who you are
La nuit is soft on your hand
E il cielo just understands

Your smile turns slow in the glass
O tempo lets moments pass
I keep one song in my pocket
For when your eyes unlock it

[Pre-Chorus]
Sing with me, sing it back
Devagar, don’t let it crack
Dis-moi oui, stay this close
One more note, then we both

[Chorus]
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Meu bem, stay right here
Dans ma voix, come near

Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
E con me, let it stay
All night, all day

[Verse 2]
A silver spoon on the saucer
Your laugh gets brighter, softer
Je prends la main, you lean in
And the room starts to spin

The trumpets fold like a scarf
Tenor cuts through the dark
We trade our names like fire
Then burn a little higher

[Pre-Chorus]
Sing with me, sing it back
Devagar, don’t let it crack
Dis-moi oui, stay this close
One more note, then we both

[Chorus]
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Meu bem, stay right here
Dans ma voix, come near

Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
E con me, let it stay
All night, all day

[Bridge]
Canta baixo, sweetheart
Je t’attends from the start
Ti prometto, no regret
Just one kiss, one cigarette

[Final Chorus]
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Meu bem, stay right here
Dans ma voix, come near

Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
E con me, let it stay
All night, all day

Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
Oh, mio cuore, don’t stray
Sing me home this way
